meta.description: Deterministic trade-by-trade actions across 4,518 sessions (2008–2026) for 5 distinct execution systems.

cv5_p.name: C-v5-P (Primary Challenger · Multi-Regime)

cv2_cash_sma.name: C-v2 Cash-until-SMA20 (Pure Persistence)
cv2_cash_sma.description: 100% Cash shift on C-v2 alert, persisting in T-Bills until EGX 30 Close crosses above SMA20.

cv2_ladder.name: C-v2 Full Ladder (Staged Dip Accumulation)
cv2_ladder.description: 100% Cash shift on alert, then accumulating 25% equity tranches at −15%, −30%, −45%, −60% drops.
